frontmatterPrompt.properties:
title: concise, one-line note title
summary: 1-3 sentence note summary
tags: YAML list of relevant keywords
created: YYYY-MM-DD date when appropriate
category: broad content category
frontmatterPrompt.prompt:
Generate YAML frontmatter for the current Obsidian note using the requested properties below.

Requested properties:
{properties}

Output language for generated values: {language}

Rules:
- Return only one complete YAML frontmatter block wrapped in --- delimiters.
- Use the target text as the note content.
- Follow current and sibling-note frontmatter conventions from context when provided.
- Keep values concise, practical, and useful for filtering or browsing.
- Do not add explanations or markdown fences outside the YAML block.

customPromptTemplates.name: 📝 Summarize Key Points
customPromptTemplates.prompt:
Analyze the structure of {{file:content}} and focus on:
{{selection}}

Please provide:
1. A concise overview
2. The key points
3. Suggestions for improvement

customPromptTemplates.name: Extract Tasks
customPromptTemplates.prompt:
Today's date is {{date}}. Extract all actionable tasks from {{file:content}}, with special attention to:
{{selection}}

Please output strictly in Obsidian Tasks plugin format, one task per line:

- [ ] Task description ⏫/🔼/🔽/⏬ priority
- [ ] Task description 📅 YYYY-MM-DD due date
- [ ] Task description ⏰ YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm reminder
- [ ] Task description 🛫 YYYY-MM-DD start date
- [ ] Task description 🔁 every day/week/month recurrence
- [ ] Task description #tag #project

Extraction rules:
1. If the text implies urgency such as urgent, ASAP, immediately, or today, add ⏫.
2. If it implies near-term timing such as tomorrow, this week, or soon, add 🔼.
3. Convert explicit dates to 📅 YYYY-MM-DD.
4. Convert explicit times to ⏰ YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm when possible.
5. Add recurrence for repeated work such as 🔁 every week/month.
6. Add practical tags for each task.

Example output:
- [ ] Finish project report ⏫ 📅 2026-04-25 #work
- [ ] Weekly team sync 🔁 every week on Monday ⏰ 09:00 #meeting
- [ ] Follow up on client request 🔼 📅 2026-04-23 #follow-up
